title: Effect of preoperative keratometry on visual outcomes after small-incision lenticule extraction for myopia

indication: myopia (retrospective consecutive SMILE eyes; flat and steep cornea groups defined by mean preoperative keratometry beyond one SD of the cohort mean, each stratified by the degree of SE corrected)

groups.description: Flat cornea group (mean preoperative K below the cohort mean minus 1 SD) with low myopia (SE corrected 0.00 to −2.99 D per Methods; Table 1 label '< − 3'); SMILE (VisuMax), single surgeon
Flat cornea group with moderate myopia (SE corrected −3.00 to −5.99 D per Methods; Table 1 label '− 3 ~ − 6'); SMILE (VisuMax), single surgeon
Flat cornea group with high myopia (SE corrected from −6.00 D per Methods; Table 1 label '≥ − 6'); SMILE (VisuMax), single surgeon
Steep cornea group (mean preoperative K above the cohort mean plus 1 SD) with low myopia (SE corrected 0.00 to −2.99 D per Methods; Table 1 label '< − 3'); SMILE (VisuMax), single surgeon
Steep cornea group with moderate myopia (SE corrected −3.00 to −5.99 D per Methods; Table 1 label '− 3 ~ − 6'); SMILE (VisuMax), single surgeon
Steep cornea group with high myopia (SE corrected from −6.00 D per Methods; Table 1 label '≥ − 6'); SMILE (VisuMax), single surgeon

exclusions.what: Table 1 P value column (C5) and P value rows (R9, R13, R17, R21)
Tables 2-4 (regression slopes of postoperative SE or keratometric change on preoperative keratometry)
Table 5 (preoperative and 12-month SE, efficacy, safety and predictability by subgroup)
exclusions.reason: SE cells repeat the Table 1 subgroups (same eyes); proportions and indices are not admissible

exclusions.what: Whole flat and steep cornea groups and the full 814-eye cohort
exclusions.reason: not tabulated over time (preoperative means in text only); the tabulated subgroups are extracted instead of the whole groups

notes: Target: Methods state 'All eyes were targeted for emmetropia'; the authors' nomogram adds a percentage adjustment to the attempted sphere (age-dependent), still aiming at emmetropia; target recorded as plano.
Method: manifest refraction at each visit (Methods: preoperative and postoperative assessments include manifest refraction).
Subgroups by preoperative keratometry and by degree of SE corrected are patient-condition subgroups, all control.
Inclusion requires at least 12 months of follow-up (retrospective review of consecutive eyes); selection by follow-up length, not by a refractive outcome.
Both eyes of patients may be included (121 eyes of 66 patients flat, 126 eyes of 73 patients steep).
The 3- and 6-month cells of the flat-K low-myopia subgroup print identical text (possible duplication in the source table; kept as printed).
Keratometric changes are tabulated as regression slopes only (not extracted).
